purpose: Grounded, citable registry of the 11 canonical platform-replication benchmark families defined in docs/doctrines/008-doctrine-platform-replication-plane.md section 7. tools/benchmark/query-benchmark-ratio.mjs reads this file plus the live crates/chronica-platform-plane/.chronica/sub-cap-arch.jsonl shard to compute a benchmark coverage ratio. This file is hand-curated doctrine evidence, not generated; update it only when the cited docs/code actually change, and cite the new evidence.
note_on_shard_evidence: Per docs/doctrines/008-doctrine-platform-replication-plane.md section 7: all platform.replicate_* rows are tracked in crates/chronica-platform-plane/.chronica/sub-cap-arch.jsonl as unimplemented governed_by_contract/targets links to crate:chronica-platform-plane -- that is claim-gate tracking evidence, not evidence that the family's own implementation crate(s) carry a matching capability row in their own shard. query-benchmark-ratio.mjs computes shard_evidence live from that one shard file; it does not claim the family's implementation crates are shard-synced to this benchmark family.
